source: Physical part to be remanufactured: IEC 60072-1 frame-90 drive-end shaft extension (D = 24 j6, E = 50, F = 8, G = 20, GA = 27, DB = M8). D, E, F, G cross-checked against a published IEC frame-size table; GA = 27 and DB = M8 as verified by the authors from the CAD geometry (GA = 24 + 3; tap drill 6.8 for M8). The catalogue CAD shows the feather key fitted; the shaft itself carries a milled keyway 8 x 4 x 40 and an M8-tapped centre hole. Required operation families use the pipeline's own vocabulary (knowledge/rules/machining_rules.swrl).

features.description: chamfer 0.5 x 45 deg at the shoulder
15 deg conical transition Ø23.6 to Ø24
upper body (shaft extension) Ø24 j6 x 46.5
end chamfer 1 x 45 deg, Ø24 to Ø22
centre hole: tap drill Ø6.8 x 19, 118 deg point
centre hole: 60 deg countersink to Ø12.2

features.note: not modelled in the CAD; the SKL has no thread feature class and no threading or tapping operation

features.description: keyway 8 x 4 x 40 with full-radius ends (key fitted afterwards, assembly not machining)

auxiliary_rule: an auxiliary operation counts as the correct family at step level only when the entity's label also yields the required operation (e.g. pilot drilling planned from a Counterbore entity that is also counterbored)
